blocks.text: Clinical research coordinators often juggle multiple trials at once. Each study comes with its own set of sponsors, monitors, and regulatory requirements. Keeping these separate is vital. Use the folder system in Outlook to organize your workspace. Go to File > New > Folder to create a dedicated space for every active study. This prevents cross-contamination of sensitive patient information and sponsor updates.

Speed matters when you have a long list of tasks. Use ⌘ + 1 to open your inbox. Switch to your schedule with ⌘ + 2. Use ⌘ + N to compose a new message quickly. If you need to search for a specific patient email, use ⌘ + ⌥ + F to focus on the search bar. These small habits save you seconds that add up over a busy day.

You do not need to manually move every email from a clinical monitor. Create rules to handle incoming messages automatically. Navigate to Tools > Rules > Edit Rules. Set a rule to move emails containing specific study codes directly into your study folder. This keeps your main inbox clear for urgent patient-related correspondence.
If you are struggling to find a feature in the New Outlook for Mac, use the Help menu in the top bar. You can also ask Lazur to point at the settings icon for you.
blocks.title: Finding settings

blocks.text: Managing visit windows is a high-stakes task. Use the Calendar view in Outlook to track patient visits alongside your administrative deadlines. Create a new event with ⌘ + N while in the Calendar view. Ensure you set reminders for critical study milestones. If you use a shared mailbox for the site, make sure you have added it correctly via Tools > Accounts > Delegation and Sharing.

Lazur helps you stay focused on your research tasks. When you are overwhelmed by email, hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask about a specific setting or how to perform a task. Lazur can point to menu items or guide you through complex setups. You can also use the dictation feature by holding the fn key to draft emails faster. This is particularly useful when you need to document a quick update for a sponsor after a patient visit.

blocks.text: To receive the latest security updates, ensure you are running macOS 14 or later. Microsoft has moved to the New Outlook interface for all users. If you are still seeing an option to revert to legacy mode, be aware that support for those older connections is ending. Keep your app updated via the Microsoft AutoUpdate tool to avoid connectivity errors like the -3253 code.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur to read my emails out loud?
faq.answer: Lazur can help you navigate your inbox and answer questions about what is on your screen. You can ask it to point out specific interface elements or guide you through setup steps.

faq.question: Is it safe to use dictation for patient emails?
faq.answer: Dictation is a tool for drafting. Always review the generated text for accuracy and ensure you comply with your site's data privacy policies regarding patient information before sending.

faq.question: How do I switch to the New Outlook for Mac?
faq.answer: You can toggle to the new experience by selecting the Outlook menu in the top bar and choosing New Outlook.
